evidence.note: Beyond-Rule-of-5 molecular weight penalizes oral absorption.

experiments.design: Cellular HiBiT degradation and rat oral PK

mechanism: Ubiquitin-proteasome clearance of Golgi/endosomal PCSK9 prior to secretion.
predictions: Oral bioavailability F < 10% due to MW > 850 Da
statement: Heterobifunctional degrader linking a PCSK9 C-terminal domain binder to a thalidomide CRBN ligand.
title: PROTAC Ternary Complex Degradation of Intracellular PCSK9 via CRBN Recruitment
